description: This file defines an interface class ISharedMemoryHandle for managing shared memory handles within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace. It declares a pure virtual method getShm() to access the shared memory pointer.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryHandle
classes.description: An interface class for shared memory handle management, providing a method to access the shared memory pointer.

methods.name: getShm
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shared memory segment.
